name: idlereps
description: A workout plan and tracker: builds a plan around your equipment, hands you one set at a time while your agent works, and logs your progress

cueEvery.title: Minutes between sets
cueEvery.description: After you answer a set, IdleReps stays quiet for this long before offering the next one.

cueAfter.title: Only on turns longer than (seconds)
cueAfter.description: When nothing suggests a long task, your agent must have been working this long before a set is offered.

idleReminder.title: Remind me when idle (minutes)
idleReminder.description: On a training day with sets left and your agent not working, a reminder at most this often.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: No sets, reminders or notices inside this window (local time).

statusLine.title: Show today's sets under the prompt
statusLine.description: Shows sets done today, or done once today's workout is finished. Nothing on rest days.

timerBeep.title: Beep when a timed hold ends
timerBeep.description: The hold timer on timed sets (planks, holds) beeps once at zero.

warmUp.title: Warm up first
warmUp.description: A one-minute warm-up before the first set of a workout, once a day.

coachAnimation.title: Animate Swolomon
coachAnimation.description: Swolomon walks on, and the lines type out while the portrait talks. Off shows the whole line at once.

coachSound.title: Swolomon's sound
coachSound.description: Off; soft blips while Swolomon talks; or his lines read aloud (your system voice). The hold timer's beep has its own setting.
